describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a patch of bare ground. Its body, head, and limbs are covered in dense, shaggy brown fur with lighter tan on the muzzle, chest and belly, resembling a bear in overall shape and proportion. Covering most of its back from the base of the neck to just above the rump is a large, domed, glossy dark brown shell with longitudinal ridges and a reflective surface, resembling a beetle's elytra. A single long, curved, glossy black horn projects upward and backward from the center of its forehead.
